title: Twice
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. He drives past it twice: once going, once coming back, slower. The card's still there. He draws it for the cover from memory, exactly. Monday he goes in. The strip already knows; it's the cover.

panels.composition: 101 north, morning. The frame shop. The card. The Datsun passing, slower than yesterday.

image.prompt: a small car passing a low roadside frame shop slowly on a coastal highway in the morning, a card in the shop window, black and white, no words

panels.composition: 101 south, afternoon. The same shop from the other direction. The card. The Datsun, slower still, not stopping.

image.prompt: a small car passing the same roadside shop from the opposite direction in afternoon light, still not stopping, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The cover, drawn that night from memory: the window, the card, the two words, exact.

image.prompt: close on a photocopied booklet cover showing a shop window with a small hand-lettered card in it, black and white, no words
image.notes: Letter after: HELP WANTED, on the cover.

panels.composition: The rack. The cover. The LAUNDRY owner reading two words and looking at WOOD over her glasses. BARNABY. Monday.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner reading a booklet's cover and looking over her glasses at a young man with a dog, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Twice past. Monday: the job. The cover knows first.
